chapterInfo.content:
11
Gu w’aba ntɛm
1 # Mmb 19.17 To wo paanoo gu nsuo ani,
na daakye bi wo nsa bɛka.
2Kyɛ mu ma nnipa baason anaasɛ baawɔtwe mpo,
na wonnim bɔne ko a ɛbɛba asase soɔ.
3Sɛ osuo yɛ mununkum ma a,
ɛtɔ gu asase so;
na sɛ dua kɔhwe anafoɔ fam anaa atifi fam a,
faako a dua no hweɛ no, ɛhɔ na ɛbɛda.
4Deɛ ɔhwɛ mframa no rengu aba,
na deɛ ɔhwɛ mununkum no rentwa.
5 # Yoh 3.8; Skf 8.17 Sɛdeɛ wonnim mframa kwan ne sɛdeɛ nnompe nyini onyinsɛnfoɔ yam no, saa ara na wonnim Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛ ade nyinaa no nneyɛɛ.
6Gu w’aba anɔpa, na anwummerɛ nso nyi wo nsa mfiri ho; na wonnim deɛ ɛbɛyɛ yie, yei anaa yei, anaasɛ ne mmienu nyinaa bɛbom ayɛ yie.
7Nso hann yɛ dɛ, na ɛyɛ aniwa fɛ sɛ ɛhunu owia.
8Na sɛ onipa di mfeɛ pii a, ɔmma n’ani nnye ne nyinaa mu, na ɔnkae esum nna no, sɛ ɛbɛdɔɔso; deɛ ɛbɛba nyinaa yɛ ahuhudeɛ.
Mmeranteberɛ mu anigyeɛ
9 # Skf 8.15 Aberanteɛ, ma w’ani nnye wo mmɔfraase, na nya akoma pa wo mmeranteberɛ mu, na fa w’akoma akwan so ne deɛ w’ani hunu mu, nso hunu sɛ yeinom nyinaa nti na Onyankopɔn de wo bɛkɔ atemmuo mu.
10Na yi awerɛhoɔ firi w’akoma mu, na ma adebɔne mpare wo honam, na mmɔfraase ne mmeranteberɛ yɛ ahuhudeɛ.

pageProps.chapterText:
To wo paanoo gu nsuo ani,
na daakye bi wo nsa bɛka.
Kyɛ mu ma nnipa baason anaasɛ baawɔtwe mpo,
na wonnim bɔne ko a ɛbɛba asase soɔ.
Sɛ osuo yɛ mununkum ma a,
ɛtɔ gu asase so;
na sɛ dua kɔhwe anafoɔ fam anaa atifi fam a,
faako a dua no hweɛ no, ɛhɔ na ɛbɛda.
Deɛ ɔhwɛ mframa no rengu aba,
na deɛ ɔhwɛ mununkum no rentwa.
Sɛdeɛ wonnim mframa kwan ne sɛdeɛ nnompe nyini onyinsɛnfoɔ yam no, saa ara na wonnim Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛ ade nyinaa no nneyɛɛ.
Gu w’aba anɔpa, na anwummerɛ nso nyi wo nsa mfiri ho; na wonnim deɛ ɛbɛyɛ yie, yei anaa yei, anaasɛ ne mmienu nyinaa bɛbom ayɛ yie.
Nso hann yɛ dɛ, na ɛyɛ aniwa fɛ sɛ ɛhunu owia.
Na sɛ onipa di mfeɛ pii a, ɔmma n’ani nnye ne nyinaa mu, na ɔnkae esum nna no, sɛ ɛbɛdɔɔso; deɛ ɛbɛba nyinaa yɛ ahuhudeɛ.

Aberanteɛ, ma w’ani nnye wo mmɔfraase, na nya akoma pa wo mmeranteberɛ mu, na fa w’akoma akwan so ne deɛ w’ani hunu mu, nso hunu sɛ yeinom nyinaa nti na Onyankopɔn de wo bɛkɔ atemmuo mu.
Na yi awerɛhoɔ firi w’akoma mu, na ma adebɔne mpare wo honam, na mmɔfraase ne mmeranteberɛ yɛ ahuhudeɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!

app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
